scope: Primary same-architecture MLP task-driven evaluation on original univariate data; independent Ridge is secondary and not run here
pretraining: One raw-history MLP per seed; early stopping on selection-only histories; explicitly reload the minimum-selection-loss checkpoint even if training reaches the maximum epoch; all five branches copy exactly the same pretrained parameters

branch_meanings.raw_continue: Raw inputs, no input gate; equal number of proxy updates
branch_meanings.half_continue: Constant 0.5 times raw input before proxy; no gate training
branch_meanings.ssa7_continue: Fixed first seven SSA components before proxy; no gate training
branch_meanings.global_gate: Single trainable sigmoid logit initialized at zero; shared across windows/components/time; alternate logit then proxy updates
branch_meanings.task_full: All 144 elementary SSA components plus exact residual; TASK-style shared features and retention head; alternate head then proxy updates

optimizer: AdamW weight_decay=.004, AMSGrad=True, cosine alpha=.9; global gradient clip=1.0; separate gate and proxy optimizers where applicable
batch_order: Same seed+1000 permutation stream and same batch size in every branch
checkpoint: Minimum selection MSE among epochs 0..15 for every branch; run all 15 epochs; restore proxy and gate together
primary_endpoint: Assessment MAE/RMSE from the paired trained proxy on each branch's own inputs; compare task_full against raw_continue
mechanism_controls: task_full versus learned single global scale
assessment_policy: Original 54 validation windows; not used for new pretraining, epoch selection or rule choice; accessed for scoring after each branch checkpoint has been selected
data_limits: This assessment period was explored in earlier rounds; this is not a virgin holdout or a final confirmatory test
training_budget_note: Same number of proxy optimizer updates; gate updates add compute and up to 33 parameters, so not equal FLOPs or total optimizer steps
